candidates.requirement: For a valid parsed stream, the target must pass parsed events to yaml_emitter_emit.

candidates.failure_condition: When the first event is a stream-start event, successful copy_event returns 1; the harness interprets 1 as failure and jumps to cleanup before yaml_emitter_emit.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry and copy_event helper show no other emitter call before cleanup.
